mainEntity.name: How do you confirm a 3.5 V8 engine fits my Discovery 1?

acceptedAnswer.text: We check the engine number, VIN and registration, then compare the sump, mounts, ancillaries and fuel system with the replacement. Rover V8 engines from other vehicles can differ, so compatibility is confirmed before supply.

mainEntity.name: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt Rover V8 engines compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your original V8. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a Rover V8 3.5 engine supply only?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages, restorers and private customers can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of a Discovery 1 3.5 V8 engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any ancillary parts needed for the fuel or cooling system, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

mainEntity.name: Do replacement 3.5 V8 engines come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver Rover V8 engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does a 3.5 V8 engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.
